Ipv6 Config Resource Get Ipv6 Configuration
GET
https://api.zsapi.net/zia/api/v1/ipv6config

Gets the IPv6 configuration details for the organization. For information about IPv6 support, see Understanding IPv6 Support.

Responses
​
200

Successful Operation

APPLICATION/JSON
Schema
Example (auto)
SCHEMA
ipV6Enabled
boolean

If set to true, IPv6 support is enabled for your organization. You can forward IPv6 traffic to the Zscaler service and enforce security policies. If set to false, IPv6 support is disabled for your organization.

natPrefixes
object[]
dnsPrefix
object[]
